newsitem.title: USA: Mattel, Tyco say FTC seeks more merger info.
newsitem.headline: Mattel, Tyco say FTC seeks more merger info.

text.p: Mattel Inc and Tyco Toys Inc said Monday that the Federal Trade Commission has asked for more information regarding their proposed merger.
As a result, the waiting period for federal antitrust review has been extended until 20 days after both parties comply with the resquest, the companies said.
Both companies said they intend to reply to the request promptly.
Mattel, the nation's biggest toymaker, and Tyco, ranked third in the industry, announced in November they would merge in a stock deal then valued at $755 million.
The deal, expected to be accretive in the first year, has been expected to close in the first half of 1997.
